issues.on_page: Cash fund balances - beginning 1,637,328 (Actual Budgetary Basis, all governmental funds)
issues.issue: Notes say no beginning cash is printed, but the p9 budgetary comparison schedule prints a beginning cash fund balance of 1,637,328. Its ending figure, 1,817,940, equals the p3 Total Governmental Funds cash 1,782,327 plus investments 35,613, so the beginning figure is printed cash and investments combined. It is left null, which is defensible because the cash/investments split isn't printed, but a person should decide whether to record it.

The same printed label 'Intergovernmental' is intergovernmental/state aid on the p4 statement lines but federal grants here, taken from the fund name (ARP), with a computed note. This is defensible but doesn't follow the same-label-same-category rule.
